draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.39, the 25th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 1st of 13 at QB. He went 1st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2024) ranked 2nd in passing yards among the 13 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Tennessee Titans. 17 career games and 17 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 7 AV in 2025. Weak spots: sacks taken 55 (3rd percentile), epa per dropback -0.18 (13th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 quarterback who played: 3,169 passing yards against a median of 1,341, above the norm.
